sentences.en: Hamilton Benn and four French were attached for smoke screen, inshore and rescue work, and the whole force was under Commodore Hubert Lynes.

sentences.en: Benn (History of English Rationalism in the zgth Cent.) goes beyond ordinary usage in defining rationalism as a militant theory opposed to all belief in God.

sentences.en: There are times, so they say, when Tony Benn also looks amiable.

sentences.en: Benn always looked immaculate, well dressed, so prim and proper.
